name: Ted Horn
features: fair skin, dark hair, dark eyes, square jaw, thick dark eyebrows, solid build, level unflinching expression
bio: Eylard Theodore Horn finished in the top four at Indianapolis nine times in ten starts without ever winning it, and took the AAA National Championship three years running from 1946 to 1948 — the first man to do so. He was killed at DuQuoin in October 1948, still leading the championship.
